notes: §2002:14.6.6 rule 2 a) excludes only intrinsic functions and the binary and floating-point usages from the composite of operands, so at COBOL-2002 a floating-point literal counts (by the digits of its significand) and the 36-digit composite of ADD 1.234567890123456789E0 TO X is refused COBOL0805; kb/Work PB5642. From COBOL-2014 the literal is excluded (§2014:14.7.6 rule 2).
